Moss Fotballklubb is a Norwegian football club, founded on 28 August 1906. They play in the 1. divisjon, the second highest division in the Norwegian football league system. They played in the Norwegian top flight between 1937–1939, 1953–54, 1977–1985, 1987–1990, 1996 and 1998–2002. The club came close to earning promotion to the top flight in 2024, but lost the play-off against Haugesund.
